:::{#def-factorial}
#### Factorial

For a [non-negative integer](#def-nonnegative-integers) $n$,
the **factorial** of $n$ [@wikipedia_factorial],
written $\factorial{n}$,
is $1 \cdot 2 \cdots n$,
the [natural numbers](#def-natural-numbers) from 1 to $n$ multiplied together.
For $n = 0$ there is nothing to multiply,
and $\factorial{0} = 1$.

:::
